missing_from_plan.why: In scope (장관은 국무위원) but no lineage key fits. 법률 제5529호 abolished it and split its functions between 문화관광부 (방송행정·출판·간행물·해외홍보, 부칙 제3조 table) and a 공보실 under the PM whose 실장 is 별정직, not a 국무위원. The later 국정홍보처 (1999-2008) was not a 국무위원 office.
options: add a key such as 'information' used only for these three days
map to culture because 문화관광부 took the broadcasting and overseas-PR functions

missing_from_plan.why: In scope (제22조의2②, 장관은 국무위원으로 보한다). It ran in parallel with 행정자치부 (interior), so mapping it to interior would give the interior lineage two holders at once. It merged back into 행정안전부 on 2017-07-26.
options: map to interior and flag the overlap as a parallel office

lineage_gaps.why: 정보통신부 abolished, functions went to 지식경제부·행정안전부·문화체육관광부 and to 방송통신위원회 (not 국무위원).
Inside 재정경제원 until 1998-02-27, then 기획예산위원회 and 예산청, neither a 국무위원 office.
중소기업청 head was not a 국무위원.
국가보훈처 head was never a 국무위원, even at 장관급.
No 정무장관 or 특임장관 provision in 법률 제5529호 through 법률 제8852호. After 2013-03-22 none again.

hearing_law_timeline.change: 국무총리 appointment requires the consent of the National Assembly (임명동의). 국무위원 are appointed by the President on the PM's recommendation, with no Assembly step.
국회법 creates the 인사청문특별위원회 to examine, among others, the 국무총리 임명동의안 (제46조의3) and the 인사청문회 (제65조의2). First legal basis for PM hearings.
인사청문회법 enacted. 부칙② deems the 국무총리(李漢東) 임명동의 인사청문특별위원회, formed under 국회법 제44조, to be a committee under this act.

hearing_law_timeline.change: A 국무총리후보자 nominated by the 대통령당선인 (대통령직인수에관한법률 제5조제2항) gets a hearing before inauguration. 국정원장·국세청장·검찰총장·경찰청장 hearings in standing committees are added (not cabinet).
hearing_law_timeline.provisions: 국회법 제46조의3① 단서, 제65조의2② / 인사청문회법 제2조, 제6조③④

hearing_law_timeline.change: 국무위원 candidates become subject to 인사청문 in the competent standing committee (국회법 제65조의2②, 국무위원 added). The hearing is not a consent vote.
인사청문회법 implements the extension to all 국무위원. 제6조③④ let the President ask for the 인사청문경과보고서 within 10 more days and then appoint if it is not sent.
국무위원후보자 nominated by the 대통령당선인 can be heard before inauguration. Acts of the 당선인 are deemed acts of the President once the term starts (인사청문회법 제11조의2).
hearing_law_timeline.provisions: 국회법 제65조의2②2. / 인사청문회법 제2조제1호, 제6조③, 제11조의2

hearing_law_timeline.change: Before standing committees are formed (after a general election or when chairs' terms end), 국무위원 hearings can be held by a special committee and count as the standing committee hearing.

Each reorganization deems hearings requested or held for the old 국무위원 title to have been requested or held for the new title. The clauses are 2008 (법률 제8852호 부칙 제5조, for requests made by the 대통령당선인), 2013 (법률 제11690호 부칙 제5조, also for 당선인 requests), 2014 (법률 제12844호 부칙 제4조, 교육부장관 → 부총리 겸 교육부장관), 2017 (법률 제14839호 부칙 제4조), 2025 (법률 제21065호 부칙 제4조 special rule for 기획예산처장관 and 부칙 제5조 table).
Current list of 제65조의2②1. (대통령이 임명하는 ... 국무위원 ...). No change to the PM or 국무위원 hearing rules found after 2010 in the versions checked, apart from wording.

national_assembly_act_art29.rule: 제29조① lets a member hold any post except those listed. 제1호 lists 국가공무원 and 지방공무원 but carves out 공무원 whose political activity is allowed under 국가공무원법 제3조 단서 (later 제3조제3항). Whether that carve-out covers 국무총리 and 국무위원 rests on 국가공무원법 and its 시행령, which were not fetched for this inventory.
제29조① (겸직 금지) reads '의원은 국무총리 또는 국무위원의 직 이외의 다른 직을 겸할 수 없다'. The PM and 국무위원 posts are expressly allowed.

law_go_kr_artifacts.issue: law.go.kr version list shows an entry effective 1998-03-01 (MST 5924, 법률 제4892호 of 1995-01-05, a 특허 related 타법개정). Its text is the pre-1998 structure. 법률 제5529호 (1998-02-28) had already replaced the whole act, so this entry does not describe the law in force on 1998-03-01.
Entry effective 1999-08-06 (MST 58502, 타법개정 법률 제5809호 of 1999-02-05) shows the text before 법률 제5982호 (still 기획예산위원회, no 기획예산처). Treated as stale.
Entry effective 2005-07-01 (MST 66292, 타법개정 법률 제7289호 of 2004-12-31) shows 여성부 in 제26조 although 여성가족부 took effect 2005-06-23. Treated as stale.

The eflaw record for 법률 제7217호 is labelled efYd 2004-09-23 and already shows 부총리 3인, but 부칙 제1조 단서 delays 제19조의2①③⑥ to the date the 과학기술부 직제 took effect. That decree (대통령령 제18561호) was promulgated and took effect 2004-10-18. The decree's own 제개정이유 describes 법률 제7217호 as '2004. 9. 23. 공포·시행', which refers to the act as a whole.
The eflaw record for 법률 제7413호 is labelled efYd 2005-03-24 and already shows 여성가족부, but 부칙 제1조제1호 delays 제26조①·제42조 to the date the 여성가족부 직제 took effect (대통령령 제18873호, 2005-06-23).

uncertainties: 1998-02-28 onward. 법률 제5529호 took effect on 1998-02-28. SOURCES_TOOLKIT.md reports 1998-03-04 news items about the first 김대중 cabinet, but this inventory did not open or verify them, so the appointment date is left to the roster. The law's 부칙 transfers 사무 and non-정무직 staff (제3조①②) but does not say who held the new ministerial posts in between. The roster must decide whether outgoing YS-era ministers count as holders of the successor offices for these days. See transitional_staff_clauses for how each later act treats 정무직 staff. None of the acts checked deems a sitting 장관 to be appointed to the renamed office (the 2008 act does so only for the 대통령비서실장, 부칙 제2조④).

1998-02-25 to 1998-02-27. The window opens with the YS-era structure. Holders of the offices listed for these three days, and the date the YS-era 국무총리 left office, must come from the roster sources, not from this inventory.

부총리 겸 과학기술부장관. The legal start is 2004-10-18 (부칙 제1조 단서 of 법률 제7217호 plus 대통령령 제18561호). law.go.kr shows 2004-09-23 for the whole act. If the roster uses the date the first holder was designated, check the gazette.
특임장관 is optional under 정부조직법 제17조 (2008). The inventory gives the legal existence 2008-02-29 to 2013-03-22. Periods with no appointee must come from the roster.
2026-10-02 and later changes (공소청, 중대범죄수사청) fall after the cutoff and do not change any 국무위원 office.
Exact times of the 2004-05-14, 2017-03-10, 2025-03-24 and 2025-04-04 헌재 decisions were not taken from a saved source. Only dates are given for those events.
The presidential term-end dates for 김대중, 노무현, 이명박 and 문재인 are derived from the successor's term start under 공직선거법 제14조①, not from a separate source.
